run_SE2_inverse_optimization: run the SE2 inverse optimization example to minimize the difference between two SE2 Lie group objects
run_LieGroupTensor_optimization: run PyTorch Adam optimization on a LieGroupTensor with configurable Lie tangent space updates
create_random_SE2: create random SE2 Lie group objects using a seeded PyTorch generator for reproducible testing
run_Difference_cost_function: run a Theseus Difference cost function to compute the error norm between an SE2 inverse and a target SE2
run_lie_tangent_optimization: run optimization with Lie group tangent space updates enabled or disabled via set_lie_tangent_enabled context manager
